transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV and broadband support, my name is Oliver. How can I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Oliver, our S-Net 4K TV box remote control has stopped controlling the volume and the power on our television, and we can't change any channels without walking right up to the box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I would be glad to help re-pair your TV remote and restore complete control over your television, Fiona. Before we begin, could you please confirm your first line of address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 78 Willowbank Road, Aberdeen, AB11 6YG, and my security PIN is 9152.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Fiona, that has verified your account on our Entertainment 4K TV bundle. Let me look at your set-top box configuration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. It was working fine yesterday, but this morning the remote suddenly lost its connection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what you are experiencing is that your S-Net 4K remote control has lost both its Bluetooth pairing for channel navigation and its infrared link for your TV power and volume controls. Have I understood the fault correctly, Fiona?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly what's happening. The little light on the remote flashes blue three times whenever I press a button.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What make and model of television is your S-Net 4K box connected to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's connected to a 55-inch Samsung QLED smart TV via HDMI port one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did the television undergo a software update or a power cut overnight, or did the remote happen to get dropped?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Samsung TV did an automatic software update early this morning! And now my elderly mother is visiting for her birthday, and she can't watch her afternoon quiz shows or turn the volume up, and she's getting terribly frustrated and upset!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Having your mother visiting for her birthday only for the TV controls to fail after an unannounced firmware update is so frustrating, Fiona, and I completely understand the stress. We are going to get this remote fully re-paired and calibrated right now so she can enjoy her shows.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh bless you Oliver, thank you so much. She is sitting on the sofa right now waiting patiently.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us first test the physical batteries inside the remote control. Have you tried putting in fresh alkaline AAA batteries?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I put two brand new Duracell AAA batteries in ten minutes before calling you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That rules out battery depletion. Let us perform a complete factory reset on the remote control itself to clear any corrupted Bluetooth cache.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, how do we do that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hold down the 7 and 9 buttons simultaneously for about five seconds until the small LED light at the top of the remote blinks red four times.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding down 7 and 9 together... one, two, three, four, five... yes, the red light just flashed four times.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That has completely cleared the remote's memory. Now let us pair it back to your S-Net 4K set-top box using Bluetooth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What should I press to initiate the Bluetooth pairing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hold down the 1 and 3 buttons together while pointing the remote directly at the set-top box until the LED flashes green.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing 1 and 3 together... it's blinking green now, and a message just popped up on the TV screen saying 'S-Net Voice Remote connected.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! That has restored the high-speed Bluetooth link. Try pressing the Guide button and the channel up and down arrows on the remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The TV guide popped right up and channels are flipping instantly from across the room!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us resolve the TV volume and power control. As I explained, HDMI-CEC standards vary between TV manufacturers, so we must pair both the infrared code and the CEC control protocol.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, because right now pressing the volume buttons still doesn't do anything on the Samsung TV.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us enter the Samsung TV manufacturer code into the remote. Hold down the TV Power button and the Home button together until the LED turns solid blue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding TV Power and Home... LED is now solid blue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now type in the four-digit Samsung manufacturer code, which is 0 0 6 0, and then press the Select button in the center of the directional pad.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typing zero, zero, six, zero... pressing Select... the blue light flashed twice and went off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now point the remote at your Samsung TV and press the Volume Up and Volume Down buttons.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Samsung volume bar is moving up and down on the screen! It's working!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press the Mute button to make sure audio muting responds properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the mute icon appears and mutes the sound immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us check HDMI-CEC One-Touch Play so that turning on the S-Net box automatically switches the TV on and changes to HDMI 1.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do we test that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On your S-Net remote, press the Home button, navigate to Settings, then System, then Audio and Video, and select HDMI-CEC Control.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Going to Settings... System... Audio and Video... HDMI-CEC Control. Found it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Make sure both One-Touch Play and System Standby toggles are switched to On.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: One-Touch Play was On, but System Standby was Off. I've switched both to On now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can also push an HDMI-CEC sync refresh to your box from our TV management platform. Bear with me for about a minute while I send the CEC handshake signal to your box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Fiona. I have synchronized the HDMI handshake profile on our end.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Oliver. The screen flickered black for half a second and came straight back to the channel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the TV display still showing crisp 4K resolution on channel 101, and is the volume level comfortable for your mother?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, BBC One in 4K looks absolutely stunning, and the volume is clear as a bell.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also test the voice search feature on the remote. Press and hold the microphone button, say 'BBC Two', and release it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding the mic... 'BBC Two'... it recognized my voice instantly and switched to BBC Two!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Voice search is responding at full speed. Let us do one final test: turn off the S-Net box with the remote power button to confirm both the box and TV go into standby together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing the power button... both the S-Net box and the Samsung TV screen turned off together into standby.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press the power button once more to wake them up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both the TV and the set-top box woke up together within two seconds right back on BBC Two! That is completely magic.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the infrared volume codes, Bluetooth navigation, and HDMI-CEC standby protocols are all synchronized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mother is smiling from ear to ear now, Oliver. You have no idea what a relief this is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please wish her a very happy birthday from all of us at S-Net!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I certainly will, she says thank you too!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If your Samsung TV ever does another automated firmware update in the future, these remote codes are now stored in non-volatile flash memory, so you will not have to repeat this setup.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so good to know, so it won't reset on us again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does that completely resolve the TV remote control and volume issue for you today, Fiona?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, completely and totally resolved. Everything works just like it did out of the box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been an absolute delight assisting you. Is there anything else on your S-Net account I can help with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, everything is sorted. Thank you so much Oliver, have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV and broadband support.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net as your entertainment provider. Enjoy the birthday celebration with your mother Fiona, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
